relationships.subject: botulinum toxin type A
relationships.evidence_quote: The upregulated NLRP3 expression in the trigeminal ganglion was suppressed 2 days after the injection of BTX-A.

relationships.subject: botulinum toxin type A
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, the BTX-A injection significantly reduced the concentrations of IL-1β, IL-18, and TNF-α in the trigeminal ganglion.

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraganglionic injection of an NLRP3 inhibitor blocked mechanical allodynia and attenuated the upregulated cytokine concentrations in the LPA-treated rats.

relationships.subject: LPA
relationships.evidence_quote: Rats treated with LPA showed a significant increase in the expression of NLRP3 in the trigeminal ganglion 9 days after LPA injection.

key_findings: LPA-induced trigeminal neuralgia upregulates NLRP3 and cytokines in trigeminal ganglion
BTX-A attenuates allodynia by suppressing the NLRP3-cytokine pathway
